title: Language Models Have Interpretable Narrative Mechanisms
abstract: arXiv:2610.12989v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We investigate whether language models contain internal components that contribute to representing narrativity, the degree to which a text exhibits narrative properties. Across GPT-2-Small, Gemma-2-2B, and Llama-3.1-8B, we identify attention heads, MLP neurons, and sparse autoencoder features whose activations correlate with narrativity. Ablating selected neuron and feature sets increases next-token prediction loss more for high-narrativity than for low-narrativity texts, and reduces the narrativity of open-ended generations. On downstream benchmarks, the largest effects occur in story completion and narrative question answering, although they vary across models and languages; results on confabulation and hallucination benchmarks are mixed. These findings provide causal evidence that selected sets of narrative-associated components contribute to model behaviour, while their internal organisation, relation to narrative theory, and broader

translated_title: 语言模型具有可解释的叙事机制
translated_abstract: 我们研究语言模型中是否包含有助于表征叙事性的内部组件，叙事性指文本展现叙事特征的程度。在GPT-2-Small、Gemma-2-2B和Llama-3.1-8B三个模型中，我们识别出了激活与叙事性相关的注意力头、MLP神经元以及稀疏自编码器特征。消融选定的神经元和特征集合后，高叙事性文本的下一个词预测损失比低叙事性文本增加得更多，并且开放式生成文本的叙事性随之降低。在下游基准测试中，最大的影响出现在故事补全和叙事问答任务上，尽管这些影响因模型和语言而异；而在虚构和幻觉基准测试上的结果则好坏参半。这些发现为选定的叙事相关组件集合对模型行为有实际贡献提供了因果证据，同时它们的内部组织方式、与叙事理论的关系以及更广泛的……（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该研究在多个语言模型中识别出激活与文本叙事性相关的注意力头、MLP神经元和稀疏自编码器特征，并通过消融实验提供了这些叙事相关组件因果性地影响模型行为（尤其是故事补全和叙事问答任务）的证据。
en_tdlr: The study identifies attention heads, MLP neurons, and sparse autoencoder features whose activations correlate with text narrativity across multiple language models, and provides causal evidence through ablation that these narrative-associated components influence model behavior, particularly in story completion and narrative question answering.
